title: 3D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Novel View Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.11894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solving novel view synthesis (NVS) for millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires a renderer that is physically faithful, complex-valued, and multi-viewpoint-tractable. No prior method achieves these three properties simultaneously. Differentiable Monte Carlo (MC) ray tracers implement the radar forward model directly with explicit material modeling and complex outputs, but do not scale to the multi-view optimization NVS demands. Optical-NVS ports of NeRF, hash grids, and 3D Gaussians train fast but discard phase and replace explicit material modeling with opaque learned features, restricting them to power-only range-azimuth (RA) magnitudes. We propose 3D Point Splatting (3DPS), the first differentiable point renderer for radar, derived directly from the standard solid-angle form of the radar equation. Each oriented 3D point carries an ITU-R P.2040 material model, evaluated in closed form, with the resulting complex phasor splatted into r

translated_title: 用于毫米波雷达新视角合成的三维点溅射
translated_abstract: 解决毫米波雷达的新视角合成（NVS）问题需要一种物理上忠实、支持复数值且可处理多视角的渲染器。此前没有任何方法能同时实现这三个特性。可微分蒙特卡洛（MC）光线追踪器通过显式材料建模和复数输出直接实现雷达前向模型，但无法扩展到新视角合成所需的多视角优化。将NeRF、哈希网格和3D高斯等光学新视角合成方法移植过来虽然训练快速，但会丢弃相位信息，并用不透明的学习特征取代显式材料建模，将其限制在仅含功率的距离-方位角（RA）幅度上。我们提出了3D点溅射（3DPS），这是首个用于雷达的可微分点渲染器，直接从雷达方程的标准立体角形式推导而来。每个定向3D点都携带ITU-R P.2040材料模型，并以闭合形式进行求值，将得到的复数相量溅射到...
tldr: 本文提出了首个用于雷达的可微分点渲染器——三维点溅射（3DPS），它直接从雷达方程的立体角形式推导而来，在保留显式材料建模与复数相位输出的同时支持多视角优化，首次实现了毫米波雷达的新视角合成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes 3D Point Splatting (3DPS), the first differentiable point renderer for radar derived directly from the solid-angle form of the radar equation, which preserves explicit material modeling and complex-valued phase outputs while scaling to multi-view optimization, enabling novel view synthesis for mmWave radar.
